data.name: Faez
data.gender_notes: Faez is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'f-a-z' meaning to open, to cause to flow, to bring success or victory. The name Faez carries the meaning “Successful, victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faez usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will be a beacon of light and joy, opening doors to new opportunities and experiences, and liberating others from their own struggles.
data.etymology: Faez belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Successful, victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faez total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_english.name: Faez
in_english.meaning: Successful, prosperous, and triumphant in life
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faez is derived from the Arabic root 'ف و ي ز' (F-W-Y-Z), which signifies success, prosperity, and triumph. It refers to an individual who achieves excellence and victory in various aspects of life. This name has a strong Quranic etymology, reflecting the values of success and righteousness. Historically, the name Faez has been used across Islamic cultures to denote someone with a victorious and successful personality. The spiritual significance of the name emphasizes the pursuit of excellence and divine favor.

The name also carries a sense of progress and openness, reflecting the desire for growth and prosperity among many individuals and communities.
